# Mouse House Workshop

Transcribed recordings from the Mouse House workshop sessions - the mice planning the Hitchhiker / Game of 42 project. Each session page embeds the source video, an AI-generated summary (key points and action items), and the full collapsible transcript.

# How it was made

Videos were transcribed locally with whisper.cpp (large-v3-turbo), audio streamed from the workshop wiki and extracted with ffmpeg, then summarised and turned into these wiki pages by the fedwiki-transcribe skill.

# Files

Every transcript (.txt / .srt / .vtt), summary, generated page JSON, and the skill scripts are attached below for download.
